description: Track A migration of computations/substrate/hecke_core.py to a symbolic-in-q variant.  The numerical fast path (hecke_core.py) substitutes q_0 at import time into [n]_q, h = q-q⁻¹, the Wedderburn weights, the Markov parameter z, and the per-generator volume formulas — losing precision for all downstream BW computations.  The new module hecke_core_symbolic.py keeps q as sympy.Symbol throughout the BW chain (NF basis, Markov trace, atom V_full, Φ₁, α_EM⁻¹) and exposes evalf_at_q0(expr, dps=50) as the SOLE q_0 substitution site, evaluated with mpmath at 50 decimal places.
approach: Approach (b) — parallel module.  Existing hecke_core.py remains the numerical fast path (no semantic changes); callers needing symbolic precision import from hecke_core_symbolic.  This avoids breaking the ~50 downstream witness scripts that depend on hecke_core's f64 globals.

early_substitution_sites_in_hecke_core.site: from q_parameter import Q as q0, Q_INV as qi, HA as h, q_int, E_CROSS
early_substitution_sites_in_hecke_core.issue: All q_0 numerics imported as f64 at module load.
Full α_EM CS-correction chain in f64 from start.
Wedderburn-Artin scaling factors fixed in f64.
Transfer-matrix recurrence runs in f64; cancellations lose digits for large A.
log|V̂_i| sums in f64 → drift on 4He+ scales.
All BW arithmetic and weights in f64.
Computed once in f64 from q0; reused by every NF multiplication.

test_summary.interpretation: Symbolic path agrees with numerical path to f64 precision (< 1e-15) for every NF basis component, both per-generator V_full values, the Markov trace, and α_EM⁻¹.  The symbolic path additionally exposes the full closed-form polynomial in q, so future drift-tracking can compare the two paths at arbitrary precision.

alpha_em_inv.note: α_EM⁻¹ closed form in (q, π) too long to print verbatim; see hecke_core_symbolic.alpha_em_inv_sym().

follow_up_open_items: Migrate atom_character_raw / atom_frobenius_norm_sq to consume the symbolic atom_V_full_sym path before BW formula final substitution.
Re-run all proton/neutron/atom witness scripts side-by-side and quantify per-witness drift between hecke_core (f64) and hecke_core_symbolic (50 dps).
Decide whether to keep the parallel module long-term, or commit to a Track-A1 in-place refactor of hecke_core.py once all downstream callers are migrated.
α_EM⁻¹ symbolic path still carries π² literals; document whether the Gram-determinant ratio cancels π² (it does in the leading order — only the residual ratio matters).
Cross-paper consideration: if UGB / Fred2005 also depend on these constants, they should switch to the symbolic API too.
